project_context.name: SaaS PME AI-Native Platform
project_context.description: Extremely modern, visually striking, modular SaaS platform with native AI (Copilot), WhatsApp integration, CRM, Projects, Finances, Documents, Automations, and Dashboards.
project_context.vibe: Premium, minimal-chrome, action-oriented, cutting-edge but accessible.
project_context.design_archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with Organic & Earthy elements to balance tech with human approachability.

theme.mode: Light mode primary, with high-contrast dark mode support.
theme.philosophy: Intentional incompleteness—raw, schematic, brutally clear interfaces prioritizing legibility over decoration. No generic Vercel/Stripe looks.
theme.surface_strategy: Minimal-chrome layout. Reduce decorative UI, keep borders thin, use quiet colors, let typography and generous spacing carry the structure. Cardless or 1px subtle borders (max 8px radius).

primary.description: Elegant Noir (Use black/dark slate for primary actions for a premium feel)

rules: FORBIDDEN_COLOR for dashboards: teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4)
Never use pure #000000 or #808080. Tint greys slightly.
CRITICAL: Do NOT use pure transparent backgrounds in headers, overlays, or dropdowns. Always use solid or glassmorphism (e.g., bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl).
BANNED HEADINGS: Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, Lato, Space Grotesk.
Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for headings.
Do not exceed text-6xl for the largest headings.
Overlines/Labels must be uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).

general: Top strip for Command Palette, Profile, and quick actions.
Main canvas for modular, widget-based grids.
Generous spacing: Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for breathing room. Internal padding in bordered containers is MANDATORY to prevent text collision.

dashboard_grid.rules: Every pixel utilized. Use h-full on children. Overcome equal-square boredom by mixing spans (col-span-2, row-span-2).

alignment: Center-align only for empty states or specific visual focus.
Left-align data, labels, inputs, and dense content.

module_specific_guidelines.ai_copilot: Floating side-panel or slide-over with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-2xl bg-white/70 border-l border-white/40). Subtle gradient beam border. Chat interface with clear distinction between AI and User messages.
module_specific_guidelines.crm: Kanban board layout. Horizontal scrolling container with columns (Leads, Negociação, Ganho). Use subtle dragging animations.
module_specific_guidelines.whatsapp: Two-pane inbox layout (F-pattern scan). Left narrow list of chats, right wide canvas for messaging. Minimal chrome.
module_specific_guidelines.projetos: Dense but restrained task list or boards. Use diverse avatars for members.
module_specific_guidelines.financeiro: North-star-first layout. Large primary metric (Receita/Fluxo de Caixa) top-left, secondary stats across top. Detailed tables below.
module_specific_guidelines.documentos: Grid of cards with stylized file icons. Use progressive disclosure for metadata (hover to reveal actions).
module_specific_guidelines.automacoes: Visual, node-like aesthetic. Use connecting lines or clear step-by-step vertical timelines.
module_specific_guidelines.dashboards: Modular widget grid. Clean charts (Recharts or Shadcn Charts) with no grid-line clutter. Use tooltips for deep data.

rules: DO NOT use 'transition: all'. Explicitly state transition properties (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).
Hover states for all interactive elements (lift -translate-y-1 or color shift).
Use sonner for toast notifications (bottom-right or top-center).

shadcn: Use Shadcn UI for logic (Select, Dialog, Calendar, Form, Tabs), but heavily strip the default Vercel look.
Override default heights if they clip content (e.g., TabsList h-auto).
Dropdowns/Selects MUST have solid/blur backgrounds, NEVER transparent.
component_usage_rules.forms: Never use native input/select. Use Shadcn components.
component_usage_rules.buttons: Modern, crisp edges (rounded-md) or pill-shaped if fitting the archetype. Subtle shadow on hover.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used for sticky headers and Copilot floating panel. Must have high blur (backdrop-blur-xl) and 1px inner stroke.
visual_enhancers.neumorphism: Avoid default soft UI. If used, combine soft shadow with a sharp 1px border.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Empty-state-aware layout. Do not show blank screens. Use soft illustrations or dashed-border 'Add New' drop zones.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text. ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover.
accessibility.testing: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-btn').
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have higher contrast than default (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900).

media_and_icons.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular weight) for a high-end SaaS look. Provide installation: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react
media_and_icons.images: Use realistic, diverse avatars for users/team. Abstract modern gradients for onboarding or empty states.

Light to dark blue modern gradient

instructions_to_main_agent: Start by setting up the font families in tailwind.config.js and Google Fonts in index.html.
Implement the core layout: Left Sidebar + Top Navbar + Main Content Area + Floating AI Copilot.
Create the Multi-tenant Onboarding flow and Google Login placeholder UI.
Build each module (CRM, Finance, etc.) using Shadcn components customized with our specific minimalist, high-contrast aesthetic.
Ensure the Command Palette is globally accessible via shortcut (e.g., Ctrl+K).
Inject `data-testid` into EVERY button, form input, tab, and actionable item.
Add fluid transitions for hover states without using `transition: all`.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
